gates.findings: ASSET_PLAN.md:109-122 assumes Pexels and Pixabay are browsable without login. On 2026-09-15 that held for both: asset pages were viewable and free download buttons were visible without login. However, no free candidate visibly shows War, which the SCRIPT.md:801 shot requires. Item-specific license terms and creators are recorded below. No file has been acquired, so no rights record is attached to actual media.
